name: Overring
description: A ring with a solid disc pushed through one side of it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 78%, transparent 78%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 40%, #000 40% 78%, transparent 78%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 8%; width: 44%; top: 28%; height: 44%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); opacity: 0.72; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
